question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Selfish".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this given sentence 'When we have a (4) ______ motive, we lose the sense of the higher objective of attaining happiness. ' we need an appropriate word to be filled in the blank that will convey the sense of the sentence.
 
• **Let us discuss the meanings of the given options**:
 
 
• **humane** : having or showing kindness or understanding, especially to a person or animal that is suffering
 
• **selfish**:thinking only about your own needs or wishes and not about other people’s.(स्‍वार्थी, ख़ुदग़रज़)
 
• **selfless**:thinking more about other people’s needs or wishes than your own(निःस्‍वार्थ)
 
• **noble:**honest; full of courage and care for others.(ईमानदार; साहसी और परोपकारी)
 
 
 
• From the given options, **'selfish' **is the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank.As when we are thinking for our own needs or wishes,we are losing the sense of the higher objective of attaining happiness.
 
• Therefore,the correct answer is **option 3.**
 
• **Correct Paragraph:***There is so much **uncertainty** and confusion in life today because the goal of human beings is not clear. Each person **wants** to fulfil his desires and dreams without** considering **the interest of the other. When we have a **selfish **motive, we lose the sense of the higher objective of attaining happiness. Therefore, there is lot of (5) ______ in our life.*

45:Ta12,

The correct answer is **"Strife".**
